jobs.description:

We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and more.  
Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

**Responsibilities**

* Define primary product success metrics and guardrails to measure the quality and impact of an AI-powered incident investigation product.
* Develop evaluation frameworks to assess model quality, product effectiveness, and improvements in investigation and mitigation workflows.
* Analyze incident and operational data to identify opportunities to improve root-cause investigation and reduce time-to-mitigation.
* Partner with engineering, product, and reliability leaders to clarify analytical questions, prioritize work, and inform product and model decisions.

* Work with leadership on career fast-track opportunities.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* 6+ years of experience in data science or analytics, with a track record of influencing product strategy and decisions in ambiguous environments.
* Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to launch, including defining primary success metrics and guardrails where none previously existed.
* Proven ability to establish analytics direction and align cross-functional leaders on priorities and recommendations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills, including experience mentoring data scientists.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**

* Strong background in experimentation, A/B testing, causal inference, and statistical modeling.

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physical science

You will experience working with Fortune 500 companies and high-performance teams across numerous industries. itD offers our employees excellent benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, paid holidays, 401K + matching, networking & career learning and development programs. We are growing and we want to see you grow! Visit https://itdtech.com/careers to learn more about what working at itD can mean for you.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Amazon Leo Government, ALG Software
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Build brand-new embedded software, with no legacy code, that connects U.S. and allied government customers to Amazon Leo's satellite network. As an SDE II, you'll design, build and own fault-tolerant software components for mission-critical terminals.  
  
Amazon Leo is building a satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers worldwide. ALG extends Leo to U.S. and international government customers, including NASA, DoD and other national security agencies, through mission-critical space and ground systems. The ALG Software org builds embedded software for ALG-designed RF, optical and networking devices, web applications, APIs and cloud services that connect with Leo's satellite, ground, network, and business support systems.  
  
You'll work in a fast-paced, high-impact environment on hard problems in secure satellite communications. You'll partner with hardware, security, systems, and product teams to deliver scalable, real-time solutions. The role needs strong skills in building fault-tolerant, high-assurance software and experience with modern languages such as Rust.  
  
Onsite work is required 5 days a week at one of the listed locations. U.S. relocation benefits are available.  
  
Export Control: This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and optimize embedded software for ALG's satellite and ground terminal systems, focusing on fault-tolerant, real-time platforms.
* Use modern application frameworks for Embedded Linux and RTOS platforms to develop scalable, modular, and high-performance software in languages such as Rust.
* Debug and resolve complex hardware-software integration issues using tools such as logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.
* Collaborate with hardware, security, systems, and product teams to ensure reliable hardware-software interaction.
* Design and own components end to end, making sound tradeoffs between performance, reliability and security.
* Operate the systems you build in production, including monitoring, handling incidents, and making ongoing improvements.
* Contribute to design and code reviews, help onboard teammates, and uphold high quality standards.

  
A day in the life  
Your day might start by presenting your design for a new embedded component on an ALG device endpoint, weighing performance, reliability and security tradeoffs with hardware and systems engineers. Next, you could be in the lab with a peer hardware/FPGA engineer, tracking down a timing issue between firmware and hardware. In the afternoon, you might write and review Rust code for real-time platforms, then meet with systems and product partners to refine requirements for government customers. You'll also learn from senior engineers, monitor systems in production, and contribute to the architecture of a platform with zero legacy constraints.  
  
About the team  
The ALG Software team builds the embedded and services software that extends Amazon Leo to U.S. and allied government customers. We're a new team building a new platform: no legacy code, and real ownership from day one. Our engineers work closely with hardware, FPGA, RF, security and systems experts to deliver high-assurance software for mission-critical environments. We value deep technical ownership, rigorous design and engineering quality, and we invest in mentorship so every engineer grows. If you want your code to run on hardware that supports national security missions, you'll fit right in.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. You will help integrate AI systems into real clinical workflows, develop scalable technical solutions, and contribute to technology that improves healthcare operations and patient interactions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Backend)

Location: New York City, NY (Hybrid — 3 days/week in office)
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
Compensation: $150,000–$275,000 base + equity

About the company

We build AI agents that help healthcare providers get paid for the care they deliver by reducing the operational and financial complexity behind claims and reimbursement. Our team works on automating fragmented workflows and data-heavy processes so healthcare organizations can operate more efficiently and predictably. We’re in a high-growth phase and expanding the engineering team.

About the role

We’re looking for a talented and ambitious Software Engineer with 4+ years of backend experience to build the internal engines and systems that help us scale. As we grow, every new customer adds claims volume, users, and operational complexity. The systems you build will handle high-throughput workflows, automate complex processes, and support reliable, auditable operations.

You’ll work closely with engineering and cross-functional partners (operations, revenue cycle management, finance) to identify the work that consumes the most time, design systems to replace it, ship improvements incrementally, measure impact, and move to the next bottleneck. What you’ll do Examples of projects you may build:

– Automatic claim routing: An allocation engine that dynamically assigns work as volume, priorities, and capacity change
  
– Claims forecasting: Models that predict incoming volume and workload to plan ahead of demand
  
– Staffing rebalancing: Systems that match specialist and BPO capacity to demand across accounts
  
– Custom invoicing: Billing workflows that adapt to customer terms and reconcile automatically
  
Quality & monitoring: Checks that catch process failures before they reach customers
  
– Access & credential automation: Secure, auditable provisioning for portals and internal systems
  
– Internal metrics: Reporting that updates automatically and ties back to source data
  
– Privacy & security: Designing for security and HIPAA compliance from the start

We’d love to hear from you if

– You’re motivated by mission-driven work improving healthcare operations
  
– You have 4+ years of backend engineering experience, especially building data pipelines, integrations, and the infrastructure that supports them
  
– You care about reliable, observable production systems and building for scale
  
– You take ownership of technical roadmaps and can navigate ambiguity
  
– You thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment and are comfortable wearing multiple hats Technical experience
  
– Strong Python skills and experience with database systems, including performance and optimization
  
– Experience coordinating distributed systems and/or AI/data pipelines – Comfort working with large datasets and big data technologies

**Location:** New York City

**Overview**
------------

We’re a venture-backed healthcare AI company building advanced agents that operate in the real world to solve one of the most painful problems in provider operations: **getting paid accurately and on time.**

Healthcare revenue is often lost to fragmented data, manual workflows, and complex payer systems that don’t talk to each other, creating financial stress for practices and, ultimately, patients.

We take a field-first approach. Before writing software, we worked alongside practices to understand how revenue actually moves through their systems. Now we’re scaling our engineering team to deploy agent-powered workflows that drive measurable outcomes.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring one of our first **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** to build out this function.

You’ll sit between our largest customers and our product team, embedding with healthcare practices to understand workflows, translate real-world requirements into robust agent behavior, and ship production-grade integrations and tooling.

This is an engineering role with a commercial edge. You’ll write code, run working sessions with customer teams, and help turn successful account-specific solutions into reusable product capabilities.

As an early FDE, you’ll help define how deployments work end-to-end, including what gets standardized, what stays bespoke, and how we measure success.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own customer deployments end-to-end, from post-signature onboarding to a live, measurable outcome.
* Integrate customer data sources into our platform, including APIs, data pipelines, exports, and messy real-world systems.
* Configure and refine agent workflows based on payer rules, operational reality, and performance feedback.
* Build account-specific solutions quickly, including agent logic, analyses, automations, dashboards, and internal tooling, then partner with engineering to generalize what works into the core platform.
* Lead working sessions with customer revenue cycle and operations teams to map workflows, identify leakage, and translate that into scoped implementation plans.
* Create and improve SOPs with internal domain specialists to continuously improve agent behavior.
* Partner with the account team on renewals and expansion by communicating outcomes, insights, and technical trade-offs clearly.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, turning field learnings into clear problem statements, specifications, and roadmap input.
* Help build the FDE function, including playbooks, reusable patterns, success metrics, and, over time, team growth.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* **3+ years of professional experience** in software engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or similar.
* Strong execution across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and practical integration work.
* **AI-native mindset:** Hands-on experience with LLMs and agents, including translating business rules into agent logic and debugging failures when outputs are wrong.
* **Fluency in Python and SQL.**
* Comfort working directly with customers, running technical workshops, scoping work to outcomes, and communicating trade-offs.
* High ownership and comfort in ambiguity. You can turn one customer conversation into a plan and a working prototype.
* Low ego, growth mindset, and enthusiasm for shaping culture and operating cadence as an early team member.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent practical experience.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Founder or early-stage startup engineering experience.
* Familiarity with healthcare data, revenue cycle management, or payer workflows (not required, but you’ll need to ramp quickly).
* Experience doing the unglamorous data work that makes messy inputs usable.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Competitive base salary:** $150,000–$275,000 depending on experience, plus meaningful equity.
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits.
* Unlimited PTO, with a minimum expectation of 10 days off per year.
* Professional development support, including courses and books.
* Team off-sites and events.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Enterprise East (Pre-Sales)
jobs.description:
**About Hightouch**
-------------------

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

  

**About the role**
------------------

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer, you partner with your Account Executives to own the technical win across the full sales motion, from deep discovery and architectural solutioning to tailored demos and technical validation. You build relationships with technical champions, co-develop account strategy, and guide large organizations through multi-stakeholder buying committees and long, competitive enterprise sales cycles.

Hightouch sits at the intersection of agentic AI and the maturing cloud data warehouse, and our Solutions Engineering team is still early in building something significant. We run a disciplined value-selling motion, and our SEs earn the technical win rather than assume it.

You'll thrive here if you are curious, have already won competitive enterprise deals, and want to become a product expert and trusted advisor to enterprise buyers. You'll be closing deals independently within six months.

  

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead technical discovery to understand a customer's data architecture, marketing workflows, and business objectives, then turn it into differentiated requirements and a solution design that delivers business value.
* Design and deliver tailored demos and architectural solutions across Customer Studio, Identity Resolution, Match Booster, and the Agentic Marketing Platform.
* Run proof-of-concept engagements end to end, from scoping and design to execution and validation, to close complex enterprise deals.
* Build deep technical relationships with data engineers, architects, and marketing technologists as their trusted advisor.
* Navigate complex buying committees, engaging technical teams, marketing leaders, and C-suite executives.
* Advise enterprise customers adopting AI workflows, data activation, and agent-based decisioning, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the go-to-market strategy for Hightouch's emerging AI and agentic products.
* Use modern AI tooling to improve speed, creativity, and customer impact across the Solutions Engineering workflow.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

You bring 2+ years of enterprise pre-sales or solutions engineering experience, including complex solution architecture across multi-stakeholder buying cycles. Experience in data infrastructure or martech helps.

  

You'll also bring evidence that you can:

* Own the outcome. You carry a technical evaluation from discovery through proof of concept to close, and you're accountable for earning the technical win.
* Learn relentlessly. You pick up products, use cases, and unfamiliar technical topics fast, because how fast you learn matters as much as what you know. You ask for feedback, take it in, and know where you need to grow.
* Bring a point of view. You get curious about messy problems, put structure around them, and back your recommendations with a clear read of the customer's data architecture.
* Create clarity. You lead whiteboarding sessions and turn complex data ecosystems into clear requirements for technical and C-suite audiences, and you say it simply.
* Build trust through partnership. You command and read a room, build technical champions, and partner closely with AEs, Product, and Engineering.
* Adapt and keep moving. You're self-starting, move forward with incomplete information, and stick with hard problems until they're solved. You navigate buying committees and competing vendors, and use new AI tooling to keep getting better.

* *Travel is required for customer and team engagements.*

  

***Strong adds***

* Hands-on experience with CDPs, marketing automation, or data warehouses.
* Experience partnering with data engineering, data science, or analytics teams.
* Time at a high-growth B2B SaaS company through a real inflection point.
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command the Message, or a similar value-selling framework.

**Apply for this role**
-----------------------

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer – AI & Talent Marketplace
new_jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**

Premier Global Links LLC is seeking a talented **Founding Full-Stack Engineer** to join an innovative technology startup building an AI-powered job discovery platform and next-generation talent marketplace.

This is an opportunity to join an early engineering team and help build products that connect job seekers with relevant career opportunities through intelligent search, AI agents, and scalable data infrastructure.

You will take ownership of projects from initial problem discovery through development and production deployment. Your engineering, data, and product decisions will directly shape the platform and its user experience.

**What You'll Build**

* AI-powered agents that help users discover relevant career opportunities.
* A two-sided marketplace connecting job opportunities with qualified candidates.
* Scalable infrastructure that transforms fragmented web data into structured, searchable information.
* Intelligent search and recommendation experiences powered by large language models.
* Product features that improve job discovery, matching, and user engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using React and Next.js.
* Build scalable backend services, APIs, and data-driven application features.
* Develop and improve search infrastructure using Elasticsearch and Redis.
* Work with Firebase and Stripe to support application services and platform functionality.
* Integrate LLMs and AI-powered capabilities into user-facing products.
* Build and optimize data processing systems that transform fragmented information into structured, searchable datasets.
* Collaborate on product architecture, technical decisions, and user experience improvements.
* Take ownership of engineering projects from research and planning through development, testing, and deployment.
* Identify technical challenges, investigate solutions, and deliver reliable production-ready software.
* Work closely with the founding team to shape product direction and engineering standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2–10 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong full-stack development skills with experience in React and Next.js.
* Experience building and maintaining production web applications.
* Strong understanding of frontend development, backend services, APIs, and application architecture.
* Experience working with databases, search technologies, or scalable data infrastructure.
* Ability to take ownership of projects and deliver solutions independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Willingness to work on-site in Cupertino, California, five days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Firebase, Elasticsearch, Redis, and Stripe.
* Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and AI-powered applications.
* Experience building search engines, recommendation systems, or data-intensive platforms.
* Background in early-stage startups or small engineering teams.
* Experience taking products from concept to production.
* Strong product sense and interest in building user-focused technology.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual base salary: $160,000–$300,000, depending on experience and interview performance.
* Competitive early-stage equity.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits.
* Flexible paid time off and family leave.
* Opportunity to join an early engineering team with meaningful product ownership and influence.

**Work Location and Schedule**

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Cupertino, California. Engineers are expected to work from the office five days per week.

Relocation assistance is not available. No regular business travel is required.

**Work Authorization**

Eligible visa transfers are supported, including qualifying OPT and H-1B transfer arrangements, subject to applicable requirements. Candidates should confirm their current immigration and work authorization status during the application process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Premier Global Links LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Backend)

Location: New York City, NY (Hybrid — 3 days/week in office)
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
Compensation: $150,000–$275,000 base + equity

About the company

We build AI agents that help healthcare providers get paid for the care they deliver by reducing the operational and financial complexity behind claims and reimbursement. Our team works on automating fragmented workflows and data-heavy processes so healthcare organizations can operate more efficiently and predictably. We’re in a high-growth phase and expanding the engineering team.

About the role

We’re looking for a talented and ambitious Software Engineer with 4+ years of backend experience to build the internal engines and systems that help us scale. As we grow, every new customer adds claims volume, users, and operational complexity. The systems you build will handle high-throughput workflows, automate complex processes, and support reliable, auditable operations.

You’ll work closely with engineering and cross-functional partners (operations, revenue cycle management, finance) to identify the work that consumes the most time, design systems to replace it, ship improvements incrementally, measure impact, and move to the next bottleneck. What you’ll do Examples of projects you may build:

– Automatic claim routing: An allocation engine that dynamically assigns work as volume, priorities, and capacity change
  
– Claims forecasting: Models that predict incoming volume and workload to plan ahead of demand
  
– Staffing rebalancing: Systems that match specialist and BPO capacity to demand across accounts
  
– Custom invoicing: Billing workflows that adapt to customer terms and reconcile automatically
  
Quality & monitoring: Checks that catch process failures before they reach customers
  
– Access & credential automation: Secure, auditable provisioning for portals and internal systems
  
– Internal metrics: Reporting that updates automatically and ties back to source data
  
– Privacy & security: Designing for security and HIPAA compliance from the start

We’d love to hear from you if

– You’re motivated by mission-driven work improving healthcare operations
  
– You have 4+ years of backend engineering experience, especially building data pipelines, integrations, and the infrastructure that supports them
  
– You care about reliable, observable production systems and building for scale
  
– You take ownership of technical roadmaps and can navigate ambiguity
  
– You thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment and are comfortable wearing multiple hats Technical experience
  
– Strong Python skills and experience with database systems, including performance and optimization
  
– Experience coordinating distributed systems and/or AI/data pipelines – Comfort working with large datasets and big data technologies
